name: Morinda citrifolia extract
description: Morinda citrifolia extract (CAS 84929-68-0 ), derived from the noni fruit, is a botanical ingredient sourced for its antioxidant and preservation activity across food, cosmetic, and nutraceutical applications. It is commercially recognized under the name noni extract, which buyers frequently use as a distinct search term when sourcing this ingredient for various industrial and commercial formulations. In functional food and beverage formulations, noni extract is incorporated into juices, dietary supplements, and wellness shots where antioxidant activity and flavor contribution are both commercially relevant. Nutraceutical manufacturers use it in capsule and tablet formats targeting general wellness positioning. In personal care, it appears in skin-conditioning formulations such as serums, creams, and toners. Botanical antioxidant content supports product claims and label appeal in these cosmetic applications. Agricultural and feed applications include its use as a natural bioactive additive for stability. Its preservation and antimicrobial properties are relevant to product stability in these sectors. Morinda citrifolia extract is available as a liquid extract, spray-dried powder, and concentrated juice powder. Standard grades include food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications, with some suppliers offering standardized preparations aligned to FCC or USP guidelines for quality assurance. Packaging typically ranges from small-volume containers for formulators to bulk quantities for industrial buyers.
